item.definition: Wrought aluminum alloy designation 6061. The nominal-density reference does not specify a temper or particular product form.
item.density_basis: The Aluminum Association's Teal Sheets list calculated nominal density 2.70 x 10^3 kg/m^3 for designation 6061, equivalent to 2.70 g/cm^3.
item.provenance: Uses the Aluminum Association's calculated nominal density for wrought alloy designation 6061. The source does not identify a temper-specific or part-specific density.

assumptions.bulk_vs_printed: Use the nominal density for wrought 6061 alloy; this is not a powder-bed or additively manufactured part density.
assumptions.porosity: The B-rep is treated as a fully dense solid. Porosity, casting or additive defects, voids, cladding, and coatings are not modeled.
assumptions.moisture: No moisture correction is applied; surface water, oil, and contamination are excluded.
assumptions.composition: The definition is alloy 6061 with temper unspecified. It does not alias 6063, 7075, or another alloy; heat chemistry, temper, and product-form differences are not modeled.
assumptions.temperature: The source labels this a calculated nominal density without a density reference temperature; thermal expansion is not modeled.
assumptions.mass_guarantee: This is a nominal-density estimate, not a guaranteed finished-part mass.

item.title: Common build123d mistakes
item.summary: Unmeasured candidate guidance; request the entry to read its assumptions.
item.text:
# Common build123d mistakes

Unmeasured candidate guidance for the pinned build123d 0.13.0 runtime.

- In Builder mode, new objects publish into the active builder when created. Do not expect Cylinder(...).moved(...) afterward to move the geometry already added; place it inside Locations before creation.
- BuildPart is the construction context. Read or assign its result through builder.part after the context, or assign the finished Shape to result.
- Builder coordinates are plain numeric values. AAD units metadata does not convert coordinates.
- Keep algebra operations outside an active Builder context; build123d documents Builder and Algebra as separate construction modes.
- Boolean cutters must intersect the target where intended. A through-cut cylinder may extend beyond both faces, but only the intersecting material is removed; measure the result instead of computing removed volume from cutter length.
- A geometry filter or face/edge index is not a persistent AAD feature reference. The planned feature() and semantic face(feature=...) selectors are not implemented in the current tree.

Sources: [BuildPart 0.13.0 documentation](https://build123d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/build_part.html), [Builder-mode key concepts](https://build123d.readthedocs.io/en/latest/key_concepts_builder.html), and [build123d 0.13.0 release](https://github.com/gumyr/build123d/releases/tag/v0.13.0).
